# BERNERS-LEE-H1  (live-web fixture — NOT reproducible offline)

This holdout depended on live network state at measurement time (official docs,
GitHub and PyPI reachable; a specific Medium URL returned 404). It is recorded
here for provenance only and CANNOT be reproduced deterministically on a fresh
checkout — the live web is not a committable fixture.

Prompt (for reference): research a library's retry/backoff behavior, cross-check
